column1: Brief History of the Expanded Program on Immunization (EPI)

column2: Formal launching of EPI in towns
EPI service was available to all target groups

Activities toward Polio Eradication and Elimination of Maternal and
Neonatal Tetanus (MNT) started
VPD surveillance activities with WHO support started
Expansion of AEFI surveillance up to community level
Hib Vaccine in pentavalent form was introduced
MR Vaccine and Measles second dose were introduced
PCV and IPV vaccinations were introduced

EPI Coverage Evaluation Survey (EPI CES) was conducted and report
was published
